# Arcline {VERSION}

Lightweight Arc-style vertical sidebar for Brave & Chrome — combining a zero-React left-edge auto-hide hover overlay with a native Manifest V3 Side Panel.

## 📦 Installation

### Chrome Web Store
Install directly from the Chrome Web Store, or load the prebuilt release archive below.

### Manual Installation
1. Download `arcline-{VERSION}-cws.zip` from the assets below
2. Extract the zip file
3. Open Brave or Chrome and go to `brave://extensions` / `chrome://extensions`
4. Enable "Developer mode" in the top right
5. Click "Load unpacked" and select the extracted folder
